text: Praise ye Jah. Sing to Jehovah a new song, his praise in the convocation of his godly ones.
Israel shall rejoice in him making him: the sons of Zion shall exult in their king.
They shall praise his name in the dance, and they shall play to him upon the drum and harp.
For Jehovah delighted in his people: he will adorn the humble in salvation.
The godly ones shall triumph in glory; they shall rejoice upon their bed.
The liftings up of God in their throat, and a sword of two mouths in their hand;
To do vengeance upon the nations, chastisements upon the peoples.
To bind their kings in fetters, and their honorable ones in fetters of iron;
To do upon them the judgment written: this honor to all his godly ones. Praise ye Jah.
